card.name: Plural nouns ending in s
card.fires_on: Plural common nouns ending in -s (stadiums, branches, centers, headlines, drawers, pumps, tables, churches, screens) that follow a noun phrase or article. The pole goes strongly negative on the plural ending.

modes.label: Plural after the
modes.description: A plural noun right after the, such as headlines or churches.
modes.example: The news widget presents the<< headlines>> of the day from around the world.

card.writes: It pushes against word pieces that start with s, as in a plural ending, and favors pieces like heet, ystem and pace that continue a word.
card.plain: It fires on plural nouns ending in s, such as centers, tables or headlines.
